[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-34[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Priority roll decay: Ctrl+Enter takes the recommended roll[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]In the Ctrl+Shift+P picker, Ctrl+Enter on `scheduled` takes the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]recommended roll in one keypress, and the date it will write is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]shown on the `scheduled` row. The roll follows a configurable decay[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]ladder read from the task's Schedule Log. A level is re-rolled [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`rolls` times (default 1), the next recommended roll moves the task[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]one level down (P2 → P3), and past the last level it cancels the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]task. This works for single tasks, `^prj` tasks, counted sessions [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and Task Link sessions, and every write is a guarded, logged, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]one-undo edit.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]current date, the recommendation planner, the decay and cancel reason [/#D7D7AF]
